boundary_decisions: Incidental fixture setup is insufficient. The inventory/config/static-host five roots remain unit despite exercising production methods. Their dependencies are local maps, local validation, slices and strings.Builder.

The seven journal roots assert actual KV reads/writes/CAS or repair around real persisted state. Boot-binding reopen is another wrapper on the same running bucket, not broker restart. Capacity and pool roots explicitly stop/restart the same broker store.

All three mixed roots retain independently material local-only blocks. Capacity missing binding fails before KV; pool child proof is unconditional pending; volume observer constructors/interface checks/nil selector/zero proofs are local.

SDK handlers receive actual HTTP with synthetic bodies and merely check nonempty Authorization. This is a genuine SDK/protocol boundary, not independent cryptographic verification or true cloud/provider authority.

The extra hostboot descriptor read closes the potentially ambiguous signed-profile drift path: valid numeric memory drift reaches durable KV conflict because descriptor binding compares the unchanged digest/generation. The profile name alone earns no signature validation credit.

classification_definitions.integration: Core safety target materially crosses genuine server/client/storage, OS/process or protocol boundary. Fault injection may surround actual committed/read state; incidental setup is insufficient.
classification_definitions.mixed: Distinct material local-only and actual-boundary assertion blocks coexist; do not assign uniform integration credit.
classification_definitions.unit: Asserted target stays local/map-backed/synthetic feed/validation, including guards before any actual I/O.
classification_definitions.unresolved: Connected immutable source insufficient; separate from runtime unknown.
